mof_manufacturing.agency: Ministry of Finance, Policy Research Institute
mof_manufacturing.dataset: Financial Statements Statistics of Corporations by Industry, Quarterly
mof_manufacturing.population: Commercial corporations with capital, contributions, or funds of at least JPY 10 million; manufacturing is assigned principally under the Japan Standard Industrial Classification using the corporation's largest-sales activity.
mof_manufacturing.sample_change_control: Four-quarter differences are used instead of quarter-to-quarter differences to reduce sensitivity to the April-June sample replacement. This does not eliminate survey-population or lender-coverage differences.
mof_manufacturing.estimand: Association between the four-quarter change in MOF manufacturing corporations' short-plus-long bank borrowings and the four-quarter change in BOJ loans outstanding to manufacturing borrowers over their common quarter-end sample.
does_not_validate: equality of MOF and BOJ levels
households, finance, property, local government, or unresolved sectors
mof_manufacturing.raw_file_storage: not committed; the official URL is an in-place historical workbook and the recorded source checksum identifies the retrieved vintage

mlit_private_housing.agency: Ministry of Land, Infrastructure, Transport and Tourism
mlit_private_housing.dataset: Survey of Actual Conditions of Private Housing Loans, FY2025 report
mlit_private_housing.population: Nationwide private financial institutions supplying housing loans; 1,175 institutions were targeted, 1,112 responded (94.6 percent), and 1,021 respondents handled housing loans.
mlit_private_housing.purpose_status: direct purpose for the housing branch only
mlit_private_housing.estimand: Published FY2024 composition of purpose-classified individual housing-loan originations, supplemented by the published amount of apartment-loan originations and balances.
does_not_validate: the NFB, FIN, or HH_NONHOUSING buckets
mlit_private_housing.raw_file_storage: not committed because the official PDF is substantially larger than the extracted table; the stable report URL and source checksum identify the retrieved file
